Update 9/2: Amazon has now dropped the price on AirPods Pro 3 back down to $199 for its Labor Day sale (this is $50 off and actually $1 less than our previous mention).

Amazon has now officially launched its massive 2026 Labor Day Sale and the deals are flying. We are tracking $50 off AirPods Pro 3, the best prices ever on the 2026 AirTag 2, all-time lows on iPhone 17 Pro, and much more – Apple Watch SE 3 is sitting at down at the $200 all-time low for the first time if you’re quick.

That is all just for starters, though. There are thousands upon thousands of price drops across just about every product category live on Amazon starting today – even the brand new M6 Mac mini 6 is seeing some discounts already, alongside everything from Anker charging gear to smart home products and much more. Scope out some highlights below.

Apple Labor Day deals

AirPods

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods 4 Amazon Resale $79 (Reg. $129)

AirTag 2

Now down as low as just $20 a pop, the best prices ever on Apple’s latest AirTag 2 are carrying over into the giant Amazon Labor Day sale starting today:

  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29) – Matching all-time low
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $80 (Reg. $99) – NEW all-time low

M6 Mac mini

Amazon has even dropped the price a touch on a pair of M6 Mac mini pre-orders – the two most affordable configurations:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (Reg. $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (Reg. $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,670 (Reg. $1,699)

iPhone 17 Pro

iPhone 17 Pro is also on tap for the Labor Day festivities as Amazon’s best quality Renewed Premium units have now dropped to the lowest prices ever at up to $290 off – they include a full 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and “greater than 90% original battery life” too:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,214 (Reg. $1,499 new) – New all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,214 (Reg. $1,499 new) – all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,149 (Reg. $1,299 new) – New all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,165 (Reg. $1,299 new) – New all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,171 (Reg. $1,299 new)

M5 MacBook Air

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store has now re-stocked a bunch M5 MacBook Air configs. This includes a pair of the most affordable models you can buy, like entry model and the 16GB/1TB at $240 off, as well as a host of upgraded and 15-inch variants.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,359 (Reg. $1,599)

Amazon Resale

All of the deals below come in the form of Amazon Resale offers in the best quality it offers:

  • AirPods 4 $80 (Reg. $129 new)
  • Apple Pencil Pro $74 shipped (Reg. $129 new)
  • Apple Pencil USB-C $55 (Reg. $69)

    • Currently on sale for $59 new

Anker Chargers

Anker’s official storefront is also getting in on the Labor Day action at Amazon, with a wide selection of chargers, power banks, Qi2.2 gear, and other accessories discounted right now. A bunch of these offers are bringing prices back down to the same lows we saw during the recent Prime Day, with savings of up to 42%.
